correctness.rationale: The claim exhausts all two-element leader sets for weighted K_p–K_q barbells, integers 3<=p<=q and t>0, by the eight symmetry orbits GG,IG,GI,II,GA,GB,AA,BB. Internal zero-sum follower modes contribute 1/p and 1/q eigen-reciprocals and the at-most-four-dimensional gateway/constant quotient gives explicit rational inverse traces. The six exact sign factorizations discard every orbit except IG and II; their difference t[p^2(q+2)-4(q-p)t]/[q(p+2t)(pq+2(p+q)t)] has positive denominator, gives unique switch t*=p^2(q+2)/[4(q-p)] for p<q, no switch for p=q, all boundary ties and optimizer counts. Independent exact-rational full grounded-matrix enumeration checked 660 leader pairs across unequal/equal sizes and weights below/at/above threshold, with an independent symbolic check of switching numerator. These finite tests corroborate, rather than prove, all-parameter theorem.

value.rationale: On two natural dense communities joined by one adjustable bottleneck, the exact all-sizes/two-leaders optimal allocation changes from peripheral leaders in each community to a gateway leader in the larger one at one explicit conductance. It isolates a nontrivial centrality-versus-robustness boundary and counts all minimizers, a useful closed benchmark for grounded-Laplacian network design rather than a mere reformulation of the general optimization problem.

scientific_limitations: Only two distinct noise-free leaders, p,q>=3, unit-weight clique edges, single positive bridge, unscaled inverse grounded trace.
Not a claim of priority for the general objective or quotient technique.
